 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Leicester City host Wigan Athletic at the King Power Stadium in today's League One clash as the home side looks to recover from a 2-1 defeat against Luton Town. 
 Russell Martin's side recently put together consecutive wins over Bromley and Doncaster before falling to Luton.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Leicester currently sit 13th in the table with 15 points after suffering back-to-back relegation and are dealing with defensive issues that have been a big hindrance despite their strong attack.
 On the other hand, Wigan Athletic find themselves in a far more worrying position, sitting in 24th place with just seven points. 
 Gary Caldwell's side has lost four of their last five matches, and have earned only one point from a possible 18 on the road.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Leicester City vs. Wigan Athletic Team News & Lineups
 The Foxes will be without midfielder John Lundstram, who is suspended following a red card against Luton. Martin is expected to rotate owing to a congested schedule, though top scorer Emil Riis is set to lead the attack alongside Sammy Braybrooke and Luke Thomas.
 Emil Riis during the Sky Bet League One 2026/27 match between Leicester City and Doncaster Rovers.Plumb Images / Getty Images
 Wigan face an even tougher challenge as they are without Fraser Murray who serves a suspension, while Luke Harris and Max Power are completely ruled out with injuries. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The main positive for the visitors is the resurgence of striker Christian Saydee, who has scored in consecutive matches since returning to the squad.
 Leicester City predicted lineup: 
 McCarthy; O'Hora, Souttar, Okoli; Alves, Page, Smallbone, Thomas; Braybrooke, Cullen; Riis 
 Wigan Athletic predicted lineup:  
 Whitworth; Fox, Carragher, Burns; Barrett, Weir, Walsh, Burrowes, A. Harris; Saydee, Hogan
 How & Where to Watch Leicester City vs. Wigan Athletic 
 The League One match is available to watch live on Sky Sports+ in the UK. Fans can also stream the action using the Sky Go app, the Sky Sports app, or with a NOW Sports Membership and kick off takes place at 7:45 PM GMT
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Viewers in the USA can follow the broadcast options via EFL streaming providers or tracking platforms like Live Soccer TV. Coverage depends on weekly EFL broadcast selections across partner networks, with soccer tracking sites listing live match updates and confirmed streams. Kickoff is at 3:45 PM EDT.
